fieldNotes.location: Bldg 3 dairy/bottling plant identified by milk silos + rooftop ammonia refrigeration/process equipment; distinct from the giant Fry's/Kroger DC to the north on the same 500 S 99th Ave campus.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Shared private fenced campus with a single controlled access off the north (Lower Buckeye) road; entrance throat pinches between trailer rows and the DC. No discrete gate arm resolvable from satellite; classified true on the fenced/controlled pinch-point. Street View has no interior coverage.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No distinct perimeter guard booth visible; the only sizable interior structure is a yard/transportation office set deep among the drop yards, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Inferred from gate-present + no-guard-shack; likely kiosk/app check-in.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inferred: refrigerated bottling plant typically separates raw-milk tanker intake from finished-goods truck loading on different faces; not fully resolvable.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~16 across the dairy building faces (south-face bank with trailers backed in + west-side bays); honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dairy's own finished-goods trailer area plus access to the campus-wide drop yards (hundreds of trailers campus-wide); banded to the dairy footprint.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple rail tracks run along the campus north edge (campus-level rail service).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 8.2 ac = the tight dairy-plant operational footprint, not the full shared campus.
